description: Na₇Y₂P₇O₂₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2/c space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.79 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.84 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.85 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.66 Å. Y is bonded to seven O atoms to form YO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with five PO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 2.20-2.50 Å. There are four inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent YO₇ pentagonal bipyramids and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.51-1.65 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent YO₇ pentagonal bipyramids and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.65 Å. In the third P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing PO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.51 Å) and two longer (1.62 Å) P-O bond lengths. In the fourth P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one YO₇ pentagonal bipyramid,  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one YO₇ pentagonal bipyramid. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.63 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two P atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Y, and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂YP trigonal pyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Y and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Y, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Y, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Y, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Y, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and two P atoms. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Y, and one P atom.
